text:
nina: Quick sync  I'm opening a tiny docs PR to unify the Autoscale snippets under a single "policy cookbook". Will add steady/burst/reserved examples + a short TF->SDK mapping. Ping @raj @olive for review.

raj: Good. Can we include a short 'common failures' section (quota, label mismatch, warmup)? Those are most of the support tickets.

olive: Add an explicit example that shows tenant label binding to a reserved pool and how that affects eviction priority. Tiny YAML will suffice.

nina: Draft YAML I'll paste in PR:

```yaml
scalePolicy:
  name: bakery-burst
  type: reactive
  targets:
    cpu_utilization: 0.8
  burst:
    max_instances: 6
    cooldown: 45s
  labels:
    tenant: "payments"
```

raj: For Terraform mapping, show jsonencode for the policy block and recommend cooldown as a string, e.g., `cooldown = "45s"`. I'll sanity-check the HCL.

olive: I'll add a short Node + Python SDK snippet. Keep them minimal and runnable.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4801 - docs: autoscale policy cookbook. CI: lint OK, linkcheck: 1 warning (old anchor).

harry: Tiny legal nit: use canonical SLA blurb for reserved pools: "Reserved pools are SLA-backed. Reactive autoscale is best-effort and not SLA-backed." Use exact sentence in PR.

nina: Thanks — will add the legal one-liner and a link to the handbook. Tagging reviewers: @raj @olive. Waiting for HCL sanity check + anchor fix before merging. ETA today.

raj: :thumbsup:
